SHORTCUTS_TEXT:
Every shortcut after this first part can be changed, removed or given back its default in the settings, on the Shortcuts tab.

Always the same
Up and down arrows: move in the lists
Left and right arrows in the chat list: move between the view tabs
Left arrow on a message: say its statistics; right arrow: open the post's comments
Typing the first letter or letters of a name in any list: go to it; the same letter again: go to the next
The app shows one thing at a time: the chat list, or the chat you entered, alone
Tab in the chat list: move between the list and the Search button
Tab inside a chat: move between the messages, the message field and the attach, record and search buttons
Enter in the message field: send
Shift+Enter in the message field: a new line in the message (the two can be swapped in the settings)
Enter on a chat: go into it; its last message is read out at once
Space on a voice message or a sound file: play it straight from Telegram without saving it; again: stop it
Shift with the right or left arrow on the messages while it plays: 5 seconds forward or back
Enter on a message: open the attachment itself in the program Windows has for it, vote in a poll, press a bot's button, or open a post's comments
Shift+Enter on a message with an attachment: open its folder with the file selected
Enter on “Load older messages”: load the page before
Applications key or Shift+F10: the context menu of the chat or message
Escape: cancel the latest thing under way (recording, playback, reply, edit, marking, search); if there is none, leave the chat for the chat list, or for the global search results it was opened from
Ctrl+V in the message field: send a copied picture or files
Formatting while typing: **bold**, __italic__, `code`, [text](link)
The voice recording shortcut, pressed a second time, sends the recording
Alt+F4: close the window, the app staying in the background
